answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the velvet of the next round. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the falcon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
